title: Counter notifications: the one-second spacing starts at round selection, not at send
body:
[A10] Found by lane P1 ([A515], #83 STOP comment 5967588719, HANDOFF).

The module that sends unsolicited counter notifications starts its one-second spacing when a round is **selected**, not when the round is **sent**. A round that waits for the TX slot can therefore leave less than one second after the previous round. Milan v1.2 §5.4.5 / IEEE 1722.1-2021 §7.5.2 rate-limit the counter notifications.

The existing check passes only at its current timing. Shifting the test's timing makes it fail on `main` (`f4167536`) as well, so this predates P1.

## Acceptance

1. The spacing between two counter-notification rounds is measured from the send of the first round to the send of the next, never less than the clause's bound.
2. A check fails on today's behaviour (a round delayed by the TX slot), with a mutant that restarts the spacing at selection.
3. The existing notification suites and campaigns stay green.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
